name: breadcrumbs
description: A named navigation landmark with an ordered list of links. Each item before the current page has a relative path or an HTTPS address with an ASCII DNS host and an optional port. The last item shows the current page as text.

parts.name: current
parts.description: Text that identifies the current page.

parts.name: details
parts.description: Control and technical details of a refusal.

parts.name: link
parts.description: Link to a page in the path.

parts.name: list
parts.description: Ordered list of pages in the path.

parts.name: separator
parts.description: Visual mark between pages in the path.
